negative_results.summary: Offline active-acquisition pilot on a real, pre-existing SciDocs q50/k15 oracle: the proposed uncertainty x counterfactual-impact x ambiguity strategy loses to random unrevealed-pair selection at both 10% and 20% budget (Holm-corrected; e.g. budget=10: mean deltaNDCG -0.145, 9 wins / 41 losses vs. random). No leakage into scoring (structurally and behaviorally tested). Closes out this acquisition-policy direction as evidenced-unsupported on this oracle.

The qrel-free stopping rule (built on the regularized aggregator) does not meet its own near-exhaustive quality-recovery targets (>=95% of exhaustive improvement recovered; within 0.02 nDCG of exhaustive) -- traced to the aggregator's own slow-converging tail past 60% budget coverage, disclosed as an aggregator property, not a stopping-rule defect. Severe-harm containment (0/35 observed) and cost-effectiveness vs. fixed low budgets are both met.

Oracle query-specific selector beats always-UHT (U_corr 0.1708 vs -0.0257) but no learned/hard/calibrated/selective/soft/staged/contextual gate does; selective_three_way was worse than always-UHT (-0.1121). Production fails closed to always-UHT.

Corrected qrels-based re-evaluation of production_uht found NO MATCHED-BUDGET QUALITY WIN ESTABLISHED; only cost-only utility signals present. Full-pool prior_topk_jaccard was structurally uninformative (identically 1.0) and replaced with prior_kendall_tau.

Two bounded live calls through Cohere's OpenAI-compatibility endpoint (json_object-only, then full JSON Schema via response_format) both returned byte-identical malformed Cohere output (evidence_strength: 'unsupported'). Cohere is unsupported for the frozen panel under this access path. The implementation attempt is archived, not part of this branch's history.

The native Cohere ClientV2 transport had three authorized live confirmations rejected with 400 before producing any content, each naming a different field, before a fourth confirmation succeeded. Call 1 (unprojected schema): rejected, error capture truncated to HTTP headers only (fixed afterward: cohere_native._sanitized_error_message). Call 2 (schema projection v1, minimum/maximum removed): rejected again, fixed capture recovered the exact reason for the first time: '$id' schema-identity keyword unsupported. Call 3 (schema projection v2, $id additionally removed; request_hash be312ecf...): rejected a third time, on a new field: schema_version's 'const' declared without a required 'type' companion. Call 4 (schema projection v3, type: 'string' added to schema_version; request_hash f062ea28...): SUCCEEDED -- finish_reason COMPLETE, valid judgment generated and passed full canonical local validation. RESOLVED as of call 4; superseded by the positive result in validated_contributions.
